defs.def: a boy or man who has the same mother and father as another person （同父母的）兄，弟

ex.s: There was just one thing I hadn’t counted on: My brother chose to bring his dog Toby, a 50-pound ball of fire.
ex.t: 只有一件事我没料到：我弟弟选择带上他的狗Toby——一个50磅重的小火球。

ex.s: So, when my brother showed up, I asked him to watch Toby and keep him outside.
ex.t: 多年来，心理学家将身份认同看作是某人的价值观、信念、目标和社会角色的组合。

ex.s: I didn’t want Toby to be running around in the house, and my brother wasn’t happy with driving home with a wet dog.
ex.t: 我不想让Toby在屋里乱跑，而我弟弟也不乐意开着车带着一只湿漉漉的狗回家。

ex.s: Eventually, my brother decided to leave rather than force the issue.
ex.t: 许多猫会在外面找到随机物品并把它们带回来给主人。

ex.s: A few days passed, and I hadn’t heard anything from my brother.
ex.t: 几天过去了，我没收到弟弟的任何消息。

ex.s: My wife suggested I get in touch with my brother, but I resisted, thinking he should call first.
ex.t: 它很难解读。

ex.s: I tried to put myself in my brother’s shoes.
ex.t: 它随着年龄增长而变大。

ex.s: With the biscuits my wife had made, I arrived at my brother’s door.
ex.t: 通过检查气味。

ex.s: On most weekends, my grandmother, a young girl then, and her brother would go to the ____31____.
ex.t: 大多数周末，当时还是小女孩的祖母和弟弟会去___31____。

ex.s: After graduation, she worked to help her sisters and brothers pay for their schooling.
ex.t: 毕业后她工作帮助兄弟姐妹们支付学费。

ex.s: She taught her sisters and brothers at home.
ex.t: 在家里教弟弟妹妹。

ex.s: I remember her reading a magazine while taking the part of the Wolf in a game of “Little Red Riding Hood” with my brother’s two daughters.
ex.t: 我记得她一边读杂志，一边和我哥哥的两个女儿玩“小红帽”游戏，扮演大灰狼。

ex.s: My older brother couldn’t be bothered to play with me.
ex.t: 我的哥哥懒得和我玩。

ex.s: Now I know who I am！ I'm Tyson's little brother, but that's only part of my identity.
ex.t: 现在我知道我是谁！我是泰森的弟弟，但这只是我身份的一部分。

ex.s: Her memory of her brother.
ex.t: 她对哥哥的回忆。

ex.s: 8．（1分）Amy， as well as her brothers，________a warm welcome when returning to the village last week．（  ）
ex.t: 8．（1分）艾米和她兄弟们上周回村时________热烈的欢迎。（  ）

ex.s: All through the  47  , Alia, Anis, his brothers and neighbours took the books from the library,  48  them over the seven-foot wall and  49  them in the restaurant.
ex.t: 在整个____期间，阿莉亚、阿尼斯、他的兄弟和邻居们从图书馆搬出书籍，把它们____过七英尺高的墙，然后____在餐厅里。

ex.s: As the first day of our trip approached, David, my eight-year-old brother, and I unwillingly said good-bye to all of our friends.
ex.t: 她认为世界上每个人都和她一样善良。

ex.s: As any younger brother will tell you, having a big brother involves a lot of walking in someone else's shadow, especially when you have a brother who is a typical example of "cool".
ex.t: 正如任何弟弟都会告诉你的，有个哥哥意味着很多时候活在别人的阴影里，尤其当你有个堪称“酷”的典型榜样的哥哥时。

ex.s: With just 700 metres to go, Alistair Brownlee was in third place and his younger brother, Jonny, was in the lead.
ex.t: 只剩700米时，阿利斯泰尔·布朗利排在第三，他的弟弟乔尼领先。

ex.s: Alistair pushed himself towards the finish line in the burning heat, but as he came round the corner, he saw his brother about to fall onto the track.
ex.t: 阿利斯泰尔在炽热中奋力冲向终点线，但转过弯道时，他看见弟弟快要摔倒在跑道上。

ex.s: Alistair had to choose -brotherly love, or a chance to win the race?
ex.t: 阿利斯泰尔必须选择——兄弟之情，还是赢得比赛的机会？

ex.s: His brother was in trouble.
ex.t: 他的弟弟遇上了麻烦。

ex.s: Alistair then pushed his brother over the line.
ex.t: 阿利斯泰尔随后把弟弟推过了终点线。

ex.s: “But as I grew older,” Adeline says, "and missed my brother more and more, I realized that was the only thing we had left." Corrado Piccoli’s Purple Heart medal now hangs at the Italian American Civic Association in Watertown.
ex.t: "但随着年龄的增长，"阿德琳说，"而且我越来越想念我的哥哥，我才意识到这是我们唯一留下的东西。"科拉多·皮科利的紫心勋章现在挂在沃特敦意大利美国公民协会。
